MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: normal volatility at 31.8% with broad participation; all 8/8 sectors posted positive 1W returns. Breadth is strong, although the 1M sector returns remain negative across the board.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom leads on 1W returns (+22.29%), followed by Transportation (+10.22%); KONTR (1W: +59.87% | 1M: +10.45%) is ABOVE TREND and THYAO (1W: +15.12% | 1M: -0.34%) is in RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Holding & Investment (+2.10%) and Retail & Food (+2.11%) are the relative laggards, despite positive weekly returns. SOKM (1W: -2.60% | 1M: -3.89%) and CCOLA (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -10.36%) are BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +59.87% | 1M: +10.45%) is ABOVE TREND; THYAO (1W: +15.12% | 1M: -0.34%), HEKTS (1W: +14.38% | 1M: -15.28%), VESTL (1W: +12.70% | 1M: -22.29%) and TSKB (1W: +10.99% | 1M: -1.49%) are in RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
HALKB (1W: -6.83% | 1M: -9.87%), TUPRS (1W: -5.05% | 1M: -12.27%), CCOLA (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -10.36%), SOKM (1W: -2.60% | 1M: -3.89%) and TOASO (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -14.64%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +59.87% | 1M: +10.45%) is ABOVE TREND; THYAO (1W: +15.12% | 1M: -0.34%), HEKTS (1W: +14.38% | 1M: -15.28%) and VESTL (1W: +12.70% | 1M: -22.29%) are in RECOVERY.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
The sector gained 3.32% over 1W but remains down 2.45% over 1M. GARAN (1W: +8.01% | 1M: +5.44%) is ABOVE TREND and TSKB (1W: +10.99% | 1M: -1.49%) is in RECOVERY, while HALKB (1W: -6.83% | 1M: -9.87%) is BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry gained 2.97% over 1W but is down 12.85% over 1M, with the sector rebound uneven. KRDMD (1W: +8.51% | 1M: -9.37%) and VESTL (1W: +12.70% | 1M: -22.29%) are in RECOVERY; FROTO (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -7.91%) and TOASO (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -14.64%) are BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector rose 4.73% over 1W but remains down 14.63% over 1M. HEKTS (1W: +14.38% | 1M: -15.28%) and SASA (1W: +8.55% | 1M: -14.95%) are in RECOVERY, while TUPRS (1W: -5.05% | 1M: -12.27%) is BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a moderately pro-risk stance, supported by normal volatility and exceptionally broad weekly participation. Favor selective exposure to leaders and confirmed recovery candidates, while keeping position sizes disciplined given negative 1M sector returns and weak 2W quant screens across most sectors.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Watch KONTR (1W: +59.87% | 1M: +10.45%), ABOVE TREND, for momentum durability, and GARAN (1W: +8.01% | 1M: +5.44%), ABOVE TREND, for trend confirmation. THYAO (1W: +15.12% | 1M: -0.34%) and HEKTS (1W: +14.38% | 1M: -15.28%) are in RECOVERY; monitor whether their rebounds extend.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Technology & Telecom and Transportation lead weekly performance, but both have negative 1M sector returns. Monitor whether their strong weekly breadth persists and whether Energy & Chemicals can sustain its rebound after a steep monthly decline.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided, so specific price thresholds cannot be assessed. Key triggers are continued broad participation and volatility holding near the normal range; a sharp breadth reversal or volatility spike would weaken the RISK-ON signal.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

BIST is RISK-ON, with normal volatility and all eight sectors positive over the week, led by Technology & Telecom and Transportation. Momentum is strong but many leaders remain in RECOVERY rather than established uptrends, while broad negative 1M returns and weak 2W sector quant screens argue for selective exposure and disciplined risk control.
